name: Angelic Light cuts Glare's cooldown by 30 seconds (#1251)
contract: Angelic Light 560094 is family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), EquippedItemClass -1, no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) and EffectSpellClassMask word1 8388608 (0x800000), EffectBasePoints -30001 + DieSides 1 = -30000; Glare (805583 and its higher ranks) carries that exact word1 bit in SpellFamilyFlags_2. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, ...) unconditionally whenever a matching spell is cast; spell_modifier exercises the same ApplySpellMod path synthetically with no cast. This is not "no server-side implementation": the cooldown reduction already applies. Effect 1 reuses the same class mask with SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (10) but EffectBasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, a zero-magnitude leftover in the shipped record; spell_cast_time_ms confirms it changes nothing observable, so it is only pinned here, not treated as part of the tooltip's promise (which names only the cooldown).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Talent's Glare cooldown drops by exactly 30s
Glare's cast time is unchanged (the record's second effect is a zero-magnitude leftover)
